135.DSCR:
The mind-control technology used by $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$, the mastermind of $$カイメラ$$ who plunged the $$ＵＣＷ$$ into a whirlpool of chaos, to control the puppet $$エーデル・ベルナル$$.
By means of specific words, it becomes possible to switch the target's mind into a submission mode and force them to act.
The artificial human $$エーデル・ベルナル$$ had the $$バインドスペル$$ built in at birth, but it can also be applied later in life through a procedure like hypnosis. In that case, to reduce the target's psychological resistance, the target must be made, at least once, to take a stance of accepting commands of their own free will. The automation of that is precisely the mechanism of the $$バインドスペル$$.

The automation of that is precisely the mechanism of the $$バインドスペル$$.
$$ＡＧ$$ carried out this procedure over a long period of time on the people who visited the $$Ｄトレーダー$$, and in the end succeeded in setting the $$バインドスペル$$ on all but one person, but it ran into strong psychological resistance after all, and the plan came to a halt.

136.DSCR:
Full name: $$レーベン・ゲネラール$$.
A soldier of the New Earth Federation Forces of the $$ＵＣＷ$$.
Captain of the 1st Squad of $$カイメラ$$, which is under $$エーデル$$'s direct command, with the rank of captain.
He is close friends with Captain $$シュラン$$ of the 2nd Squad of $$カイメラ$$.
Believing in the ideals of $$エーデル・ベルナル$$, he fights to reform the New Earth Federation Forces and to establish order in the multiverse.
During his infiltration of $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$, he pretended to be an earnest, naive, likable young man in order to put others off their guard. However, his true personality is hysterical and self-centered, and going beyond a mere phobia, he loathes the very existence of women.
The one and only exception to his hatred of women is $$エーデル$$, and he openly declares that he would give even his life for her.
Defeated in the decisive battle with $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ set at the central station of the $$ＵＮ$$, and told that $$エーデル・ベルナル$$, whom he had worshiped, was a puppet of Dr. $$ジエー$$, he met his final moments in a state of frenzy.

137.DSCR:
Full name: $$シュラン・オペル$$.
A soldier of the New Earth Federation Forces of the $$ＵＣＷ$$.
Captain of the 2nd Squad of $$カイメラ$$, which is under $$エーデル$$'s direct command, with the rank of captain.
He shows his true worth in rear-area duties such as maintaining public order and information warfare.
He takes pleasure in watching situations fall into confusion because of his own schemes, and has a flamboyantly wicked side that openly admits it.
Calm and composed, and never breaking a cool attitude at any time, he gives others a cold impression, but that is a pose to hide inner anxiety.
He wished to live by emotion, and for that reason both loathed and was strongly drawn to the impulsive $$レーベン$$.
Defeated in the decisive battle with $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ set at the central station of the $$ＵＮ$$, he met his final moments shouting the name of $$レーベン$$.

The $$シュラン$$ token is dropped only because it became a pronoun; all other tokens kept.

138.DSCR:
A spacequake that occurred in the Republic of $$リモネシア$$ in the middle of the $$破界事変$$ in the $$ＡＤＷ$$.
It was an artificial spacequake caused with an enormous amount of $$ＤＥＣ$$ under the guidance of $$アイム・ライアード$$, and the $$破界の王$$ and the forces under him were transferred to the $$ＡＤＷ$$ from a parallel world.
This spacetime disaster dealt devastating damage to the Republic of $$リモネシア$$, and the world was also thrown into war by $$ガイオウ$$, the $$破界の王$$, and the $$新帝国インペリウム$$.

139.DSCR:
A young man, a machine-weapon pilot, whom $$ノリコ$$ met aboard the space battleship $$ヱクセリヲン$$.
Full name: $$スミス・トーレン$$.
Having met by chance at the test-of-courage event held aboard the ship, he often teased $$ノリコ$$ on board, but when $$ノリコ$$ was dropped from her partnership with $$カズミ$$ and was depressed, he encouraged her and became her partner, and the two grew close.
However, in the subsequent battle with the space monsters, he sortied together with $$ノリコ$$ but did not return, and was presumed killed in action.
The trauma of not having been able to save $$スミス$$ became what led $$ノリコ$$ to undergo piloting training for $$ガンバスター$$.
The headband $$ノリコ$$ wears in battle is a keepsake of $$スミス$$.

140.DSCR:
The first prime minister of the space colony nation the '$$ジオン共和国$$', based on $$サイド３$$.
He was the father of $$シャア$$ (real name $$キャスバル・レム・ダイクン$$) and $$セイラ$$ (real name $$アルテイシア・ソム・ダイクン$$), and was also a politician who created the ideology called 'Newtype theory'.
After his death, the $$ジオン共和国$$ became the $$ジオン公国$$, a dictatorship of the $$ザビ家$$.
There are various theories about his death, but the theory that he was murdered by the $$ザビ家$$ is the strongest, and $$シャア$$ also spoke of this theory in a speech.

141.DSCR:
One of the parallel worlds (= the world of 'The 2nd Super Robot Wars Z').
The name is short for 'Anno Domini World'.
Its situation was comparatively stable, but twenty years after the $$大時空震動$$ it was struck by two inter-dimensional wars in succession: the $$破界事変$$ and the $$再世戦争$$.
It is marked by two Japanese archipelagos, two moons, and a continent sealed off by a dimensional wall. The wall covering that continent vanished early in the $$破界事変$$, and one of the two moons vanished late in the $$再世戦争$$.

142.DSCR:
The legendary leader of the colonies, who was assassinated in A.C. 175.
An activist who advocated nonviolence and had been negotiating with the Alliance to gain autonomy for the colonies, but was assassinated because their existence was regarded as dangerous.
